# PIDC Landing — system digest (generated by digest.mjs — do not edit)

Design v1.0.0 · 2026-10-29
Screens are LAYOUT ONLY: compose these classes, never restyle them; values only via var(--token). Missing piece → ask the Director
(new variant/component goes into the system first). Read a component's CSS only when asked to change that component.

## Components (c-*)
- **c-btn** — Button · APG button · in 10 screen(s)
  variants: primary
  states: :hover :focus-visible :disabled
  `<button class="c-btn">Mặc định</button>`
- **c-modal** — Dialog · APG dialog-modal
  parts: __panel __title __actions
  `<div class="c-modal"><div class="c-modal__panel"><h3 class="c-modal__title">Xoá khoản chi?</h3><p>Không hoàn tác được.</p><div class="c-modal__actions"><button class="c-btn">Huỷ</button><button class="c-btn c-btn--primary">Xoá</button></div></div></div>`
- **c-status** — Status
  variants: ok, warn, danger
  `<span class="c-status c-status--ok">✓ Hoàn tất</span>`
- **c-table** — Table · APG table · in 2 screen(s)
  parts: __num __row
  states: :hover
  `<table class="c-table"><thead><tr><th>Đơn</th><th class="c-table__num">Tổng</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr class="c-table__row--interactive"><td>DH-2641</td><td class="c-table__num">135.000 ₫</td></tr><tr><td>DH-2640</td><td class="c-table__num">97.000 ₫</td></tr></tbody></table>`
- **c-sitehead** — Site header · in 10 screen(s)
  parts: __in __brand __name __sub __lang __langbtn __nav
  states: [aria-pressed="true"] :focus-visible
  `<div class="c-sitehead"><div class="c-sitehead__in"><a class="c-sitehead__brand" href="#"><span class="c-sitehead__name">PIDC</span><span class="c-sitehead__sub">Pisico Data Center</span></a><div class="c-sitehead__lang" role="group" aria-label="Language / Ngôn ngữ"> …`
- **c-hero** — Hero · in 10 screen(s)
  parts: __badge __dot __title __lede __actions __legend __toc
  `<div class="c-hero"><p class="c-hero__badge"><span class="c-hero__dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>In development · Gia Lai, Vietnam</p><h1 class="c-hero__title">An international, green, resilient AI campus.</h1><p class="c-hero__lede">PIDC is developing a phased AI data center campus in Gia Lai.</p> …`
- **c-section** — Section · in 10 screen(s)
  variants: body
  parts: __eyebrow __title __lede __list
  `<div class="c-section"><p class="c-section__eyebrow">Why Gia Lai</p><h2 class="c-section__title">Power, fiber and land in one place</h2><p class="c-section__lede">Three proofs, one site.</p></div>`
- **c-figure** — Figure · in 8 screen(s)
  parts: __title __keys __cap __zones __zone __swatches
  `<figure class="c-figure"><figcaption class="c-figure__title">Building AI infrastructure where the power is.</figcaption><svg…/><ol class="c-figure__keys"><li class="c-phase"><span class="c-phase__n" aria-hidden="true">1</span><span>Phase 1 data hall</span></li><li class="c-phase"> …`
- **c-proof** — Proof card · in 4 screen(s)
  parts: __index __kicker __title __body
  `<article class="c-proof"><p class="c-proof__index">01</p><p class="c-proof__kicker">Power</p><h3 class="c-proof__title">A province with surplus power</h3><p class="c-proof__body">Gia Lai's wind, solar and hydropower plants produce far more electricity than the province uses.</p></article>`
- **c-stat** — Stat · in 4 screen(s)
  parts: __figure __label
  `<div class="c-stat"><span class="c-stat__figure">220 kV</span><span class="c-stat__label">Transmission grid</span></div>`
- **c-phase** — Phase marker · in 8 screen(s)
  parts: __n
  `<li class="c-phase"><span class="c-phase__n" aria-hidden="true">1</span><span>Phase 1 data hall</span></li>`
- **c-callout** — Callout note · in 4 screen(s)
  `<p class="c-callout">Capacity figures and technical details are shared under NDA.</p>`
- **c-cta** — CTA band · in 8 screen(s)
  parts: __in __title __actions
  `<div class="c-cta"><div class="c-cta__in"><h2 class="c-cta__title">Talk to us about the campus</h2><a class="c-btn c-btn--primary" href="#">Contact us</a></div></div>`
- **c-sitefoot** — Site footer · in 10 screen(s)
  parts: __tag __wordmark __tagline __in __nav __site __status
  `<div class="c-sitefoot"><div class="c-sitefoot__tag"><p class="c-sitefoot__wordmark">PIDC · Pisico Data Center</p><p class="c-sitefoot__tagline">An international, green, resilient AI campus.</p></div><div class="c-sitefoot__in"><nav class="c-sitefoot__nav" aria-label="Footer"><a href="#">The project …`
- **c-compare** — Compare table · APG table · in 2 screen(s)
  parts: __ai

- **c-glossary** — Glossary list · in 8 screen(s)

  parts: __label __input
  states: :focus-visible
  `<div class="c-formfield"><label class="c-formfield__label" for="cat-mail">Email</label><input class="c-formfield__input" id="cat-mail" type="email" placeholder="name at pidc dot vn (placeholder)"></div>`

  parts: __item __value __label __src
  `<dl class="c-statband"><div class="c-statband__item"><dt class="c-statband__label">Grid connection · Đấu nối lưới</dt><dd class="c-statband__value c-statband__value--red">220 kV</dd><dd class="c-statband__src">[CEO: source + as-of]</dd></div><div class="c-statband__item"> …`
- **c-ceo** — CEO content placeholder · in 6 screen(s)
  `<span class="c-ceo">[CEO: land area ha]</span>`
- **c-milestones** — Milestone list · in 2 screen(s)
  `<ul class="c-milestones"><li><time>[CEO: date]</time><div>[CEO: milestone + status]</div></li></ul>`
- **c-people** — Leadership block · in 2 screen(s)
  parts: __card __role
  `<div class="c-people"><div class="c-people__card"><div class="c-people__role">[CEO: role]</div><div>[CEO: name + one line]</div></div></div>`
- **c-choice** — Contact routing choice · APG radiogroup · in 2 screen(s)
  parts: __opt __input __title __desc
  `<fieldset class="c-choice"><legend class="sr-only">I am a · Tôi là</legend><label class="c-choice__opt"><input class="c-choice__input" type="radio" name="cat-demo" checked><span><span class="c-choice__title">Capital partners · Đối tác vốn</span><br><span class="c-choice__desc">Infrastructure investo …`
